title: Simultaneous Recovery of the Initial Source and Sound Speed for the Wave Equation under a Constitutive Constraint
summary: We study the simultaneous recovery of the initial source and sound speed for the scalar wave equation from a single boundary measurement. Although the recovery of either parameter separately is well understood under suitable geometric hypotheses, simultaneous recovery remains open in general, and stable recovery is further obstructed by the inherent instability of the linearized problem. We show that both uniqueness and stability can be obtained when the two unknowns are coupled through a prescribed constitutive relation arising from a common underlying material.
